as_of_content:
The '''Scorponok and Waspinator Story Arc''' is a story arc that began with "[[Till All Are Gone]]" and continued with "[[A Tale of Two Stingers]]".

==  Plot ==
[[Waspinator]] and [[Scorponok]] are finding materials to construct a Space Bridge that will bring ''Beast Wars'' Megatron in. When questioned by [[Optimus Prime]] on which Megatron he considers his boss, Scorponok rejects [[Megatronus]], considering the Predacon leader as his boss instead. Optimus and the Commander would later dispatch both Pred bugs. ("[[Till All Are Gone]]")

The following month, the duo continue their quest, bumping into various Bots and disrupting what they were doing. In the end, Scorponok realizes that he and Waspinator haven't attacked the [[Commander]], and do so, only to get trounced. ("[[A Tale of Two Stingers]]")
[[Category:Special Missions]]
